backup.title: Backup and restore (admin)
backup.description: Download all accounts, progress and content as one file, or restore a backup on this server. Use it to move to another domain, server or database.
backup.downloadNote: Sign-in sessions are not included. Keep the file private: it contains every account.
backup.importWarning: This replaces ALL data on this server with the backup and signs everyone out. It cannot be undone.
backup.imported: Restored {rows} rows. Everyone has been signed out.
backup.failed: The restore failed; nothing was changed.
